claim: Colin records whole matches as one continuous file with a DJI camera on the floor behind one baseline (wide angle, fixed); the camera stays put when players change ends.

evidence.observation: One 29:10 file, camera position unchanged throughout; near-side player changes after ~16:23-17:00.
A finger touches the lens edge at 1:49 (camera adjusted by hand at floor level).

counter_evidence_note: The 2024 OCAA edit used a different, higher side-court position.
